notes: Draft. gbrain master at the frozen SHA (parameter gbrain_master_sha), gbrain init defaults: voyage:voyage-4 embedder, balanced search with the Voyage reranker. Recipe arm off LongMemEval-S.

cells.lease_basis: 1.5 x estimate, not piloted: as the pin recipe row ($5.60)
cells.command: bun eval/runner/memory-qa/run.ts --benchmark locomo --split dev --system gbrain-shootout --embed real --embedding-model voyage:voyage-4 --embedding-dims 1024 --gbrain "$HOME/gbrain-master@{{gbrain_master_sha}}" --arms docs/benchmarks/2026-10-06-oss-memory-shootout/manifests/arms/four-arms-locomo.json --output "$SHOOTOUT_OUT/mqa"
cells.setup_command: bash eval/systems/bootstrap.sh setup --datasets locomo,beam-100k,lme-s && { test -d "$HOME/gbrain-master/.git" || git clone -q https://github.com/garrytan/gbrain "$HOME/gbrain-master"; } && git -C "$HOME/gbrain-master" fetch -q origin {{gbrain_master_sha}} && git -C "$HOME/gbrain-master" checkout -q {{gbrain_master_sha}}
